text:
Predicates:
SportingEvent(x) ::: x is a sporting event.
OlympicGames(x) ::: x is an Olympic games.
LastOlympicGames(x) ::: x is the last Olympic games.
Location(x, y) ::: x took place in y.
UnitedStates(x) ::: x is the United States.
WonMostMedals(x, y) ::: x won the most medals in y.
Tokyo(y) ::: y is Tokyo.
Premises:
SportingEvent(olympics) ::: The Olympic games is a sporting event.
LastOlympicGames(tokyo) ::: The last Olympic games was in Tokyo.
Location(tokyo, tokyo) ::: The last Olympic games was in Tokyo.
WonMostMedals(usa, tokyo) ::: The United States won the most medals in Tokyo.
Conclusion:
SportingEvent(worldChampionships) ::: The world championships is a sporting event.
